{{Codex|This weapon was designed to assist with the excavation of mineral deposits from large asteroids, but has been adapted for military purposes.}}

The '''Quanta''' is a {{Faction|Corpus}} mining laser cutter used by Corpus [[Quanta Ranger]]s and is the basis for the {{Faction|Infested}} {{Weapon|Mutalist Quanta}} and {{Weapon|Paracyst}} weapons, although they share little in common aside from basic appearances and similarly functioning [[Alternate Fire]]s. It features high {{D|Electricity}} damage with perfect [[accuracy]] and an [[Alternate Fire]] mode which launches explosive energy cubes that detonate on contact with enemies and weapons fire or after a short period of time.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals {{D|Electricity}} damage on its Primary Fire and {{D|Blast}} damage on its [[Alternate Fire]].
*Primary Fire shoots two concentrated continuous beams.
**Innate [[multishot]] of 2 beams.
**Consumes 0.5 ammo per tick of damage.
*[[Alternate Fire]] lobs a small cube that explodes in '''0.5''' meter radius on contact or after being left alone for '''9''' seconds. If damaged by any player in any way (e.g. explosion of a nearby cube), it explodes in '''6''' meter radius.
**Does not inflict [[Stagger|self-stagger]] and has no [[Damage Falloff]].
**Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
**Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
**Consumes '''10''' rounds per shot.
*Innate {{Pol|Vazarin}} polarity.

{{Advantages|class=Rifle|trigger=Held|
}}
{{Disadvantages|class=Rifle|trigger=Held|
*Primary Fire:
**Damage ramps up from 30% to 100% over 0.6 seconds when firing. After firing stops for 0.8 seconds, the damage decays back to 30% over 2 seconds.
**Limited range of 50 meters.
*Alternate Fire:
**Cubes have slow travel time and a limited range of roughly 15 meters.
**Explosion has a [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] multiplier of 1x and cannot trigger headshot conditions.
}}
{{WeaponComparison|Quanta Vandal}}
{{WeaponComparison|Tenet Quanta}}

==Acquisition==
The Quanta's blueprint can be [[research]]ed from the [[Research/Energy Lab|Energy Lab]] in the [[dojo]].

{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}
This weapon can be sold for ‍'''7,500'''.

==Notes==
*The Quanta is only available from clan research in the Energy lab.
*When combining elements, the Quanta's {{D|Electricity}} element is added last. This means if, for example, {{D|Cold}} and {{D|Toxin}} damage mods were added, the elemental damage results would be {{D|Viral}} and {{D|Electricity}}.
*Additional cubes generated by Split Chamber will follow a similar trajectory, however once they move far enough apart, they will likely collide with each other and bounce off in opposite directions. This effect can be avoided using {{M|Heavy Caliber}} at a high enough rank.
*Heavy Caliber will not affect the accuracy of the primary fire as badly as it does on other continuous weapons, but [[multishot]] will affect the secondary fire by launching the cubes at noticeably different angles.

===[[Alternate Fire]]===
*The Quanta has a secondary fire mode that lets it shoot cubes that travel up to '''15''' meters before stopping in mid-air.
**Cube explosion deals {{D|Blast}}.
**Cubes automatically explode '''8''' seconds after stopping in mid-air.
**Cubes can [[bounce]] off environmental objects but will explode upon impact with enemies.
**Cubes can be detonated by being fired upon by any weapon.
***Cubes detonated this way deal bonus damage.
**Unlike the {{Weapon|Mutalist Quanta}}, there is no limit to how many cubes can be fired at any given time, being only limited by the amount of ammo in the magazine.
*If an element is combined with the Quanta's base {{D|Electricity}} damage, the additional element can proc by itself during a cube explosion, ex. adding {{D|Heat}} to form {{D|Radiation}} can result in the Cube dealing {{D|Heat}} proc. This happens because when the default {{D|Electricity}} element is combined with other element to get a combined element, the combined element only works on the primary fire, but not on the explosion on the secondary fire.
*[[Punch Through]] mods modify the behavior of cubes. Instead of detonating on impact with an enemy, the cubes will pass through that enemy while still dealing its usual damage.
**Cubes can also pass through any object without bouncing, with the distance penetrated dependent upon the punch-through distance of the current mod. In both cases, the cube will lose its punch-through behavior after it has traveled its slated punch-through distance through enemies or objects, regaining its ability to bounce off walls and detonate upon enemy contact.
*The cube's {{D|Blast}} damage element is retained even if additional elements are installed unto the weapon, giving it a chance to proc on explosions.
*{{M|Terminal Velocity}} will increase the flight speed of the cubes and the distance they travel before coming to a complete stop.
*Fire rate mods shorten the time between firing a cube.

==Tips==
*The Quanta's cubes will detonate if exposed to weapons fire, including explosions from other nearby cubes. This can be used to create a chain detonation by launching multiple cubes within explosion range of each other, then shooting one of them to detonate all the cubes.
*Cubes will immediately explode when impacting [[Blunt]]s, [[Tectonics|Bulwarks]], {{A|Decoy}}s, {{A|Molt}}s and [[Rampart]]s, allowing players to instantly deal high amounts of damage.
*The innate {{Pol|Vazarin}} polarity matches {{M|Cryo Rounds}}.

==Trivia==
*Unlike the {{Weapon|Mutalist Quanta}}, the weapon's arms do not rotate when firing, and instead both ends are used to emit two laser beams that meet together at the reticle.
**As it was originally intended as a mining tool, it is likely that the laser emitters would not have aimed at the same point, but instead cut around a location, with the arms rotating to cut out mineral hotspots in the shape of a cone. As a weapon, however, there would be little use for this level of articulation. Aiming the lasers at a single point alone would be enough for a weapon. As such, the rotation would not be needed.
*The Quanta fires two beams at once. If a [[Riven Mods|Riven Mod]] with more than -50% [[multishot]] is installed, the bottom beam stops firing.
*This is the only weapon that can equip both {{M|Sinister Reach}} and {{M|Terminal Velocity}}.
*Despite the Quanta being the original Corpus version of the weapon, it was introduced into the game after the Mutalist Quanta.
*Its default colors are the same as the Mutalist version, although only the Primary, Secondary and Energy affect its colors.
*The Quanta is used by [[Quanta Ranger]]s in [[Corpus]] [[Archwing]] missions.

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|43}}
*Updated Quanta’s unique trait description to give specific stats on what it does.
**Now reads: "Alternate Fire launches energy cubes that explode after 8 seconds, or when hitting enemies. Shoot a cube to cause chain detonation with x4 Damage Bonus and 6m Radius.”

{{ver|27.2.2}}
*Fixed the Quanta not having the new ‘Status’ calculations. It also has multiple fire iterations and are valid for large Status Chance like Shotguns received at their base to address the new Status logic.

{{ver|27.2}}
;Greater than 100% Status having meaning:
Shotguns have a unique Role here based on a very patch-work history with how they interact with Status Chance. A Shotgun that shoots 99% Status Chance would give you 35% (roughly) status per pellet. 100% Status Gives you 100% Status per pellet. This huge jump in performance happens with just a 1% gain - why? Well, to answer that we have to look at our choice to make what the UI conveys reality. It would feel broken to shoot a Shotgun with 100% Status and not see a perfect spread of Effects. In reality, to make Status consistent we have to treat Shotguns as a special case. 

Shotguns as a special case means we have buffed the Status Chance of all Shotguns by x3 or greater. The UI now behaves to show the reality that you are determining Status Chance per pellet.

{{ver|25.8}}
;October 2019 Riven Disposition Change
*Quanta: 1.25->1.35

{{ver|25.7}}
*Fixed the Quanta and Quanta Vandal alt fire cube explosion sound no longer playing.

{{ver|22.17}}
*More Visual Effect intensity changes to reduce visual noise from Quanta energy cube explosions.

{{ver|22.14}}
*Fixed Beam weapons not being able to damage enemies (alive but in a ragdolled state) when being affected by certain ‘crowd control’ Abilities.
*Damage now ramps up over 0.6 seconds and after moving off target there is a delay of 0.8 seconds before it starts to decay over 2 seconds.
*All Beam weapons now start their Damage ramp up at 20% (instead of 10%).
*The Multishot chance should now apply more consistently with Beam weapons.
*Fixed Beam weapons continuously firing when quick Meleeing.

{{ver|22.13.4}}
*Increased the Beam weapon Damage ramp up time from 0.8 to 1 second.
*Fixed Beam weapon Damage ramp up not happening per target.

{{ver|22.13.3}}
*Perfect accuracy and high fire rate is balanced by limited range and damage ramping up from 10% to 100% over 0.8 seconds when firing and decays back to 10% over 1 second after stopping.
*Damage changed from 220 Electricity per sec to 20 Electricity per tick.
*Fire Rate increased from 1 to 12.
*Status Chance changed from 10% per sec to 16% per tick of damage.
*Critical chance increased from 10% to 16%.
*Critical Damage increased from 2.0x to 2.2x.
*Alt Fire Explosion Radius increased from 5m to 6m.
*Alt Fire Explosion Damage increased from 400 to 600.
*Ammo consumption decreased from 1.0 to 0.5 per tick of damage.

{{ver|14.1.0}}
*Introduced
}}

{{Codex|Compact four-barreled design packing a self-charging capacitor that discharges upon every reload from empty. Features auto hip-fire and aimed fire is semi-auto, four-shot instant burst.}}

The '''Quatz''' is a [[Grineer]] quad-barreled sidearm that fires {{D|Electricity}} bullets with a high [[fire rate]] and deadly [[accuracy]], alternating between automatic shots from hip-fire with high [[status chance]] or a four-round simultaneous burst from [[zoom|aimed]] fire with increased [[critical chance]] and [[critical multiplier]]. Reloading from an empty magazine also discharges an {{D|Electricity}} pulse that stuns nearby enemies.

This weapon can be sold for ‍{{cc|5,000}}.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Electricity}} damage.
*Hip-fire shoots fully-automatic rounds.
*[[Zoom|Aimed]] fire shoots four rounds simultaneously in a burst.
**Uniquely fires all four shots simultaneously instead of consecutively, reducing the chance of one missing.
**Each shot lands in a small square formation around where the user is aiming instead of directly on the crosshair, which may lead to misses against smaller targets.
*Reloading from a fully depleted magazine produces an '''8''' meter shockwave that deals '''10''' {{D|Electricity}} damage with '''100%''' status chance and an additional '''1''' forced electricity proc.
**Can benefit from {{M|Fulmination}} ({{M|Primed Fulmination|Primed}}).
**Shockwave does not require line of sight.
**Has '''100%''' damage falloff over its radius, dealing '''0''' damage at the edge of its range.
**Is affected by base damage, faction damage, status chance, status damage, status duration, and {{M|Energizing Shot}}.
**Is '''not''' affected by multishot, elemental mods (will not add damage or change damage type), and {{M|Synth Charge}}.
**Has '''0%''' critical chance and a '''0x''' critical multiplier.
***Critical chance can be increased with flat bonuses like {{Arcane|Arcane Avenger}} or {{A|Covenant}}.
***Critical damage can be increased with flat bonuses like {{Arcane|Arcane Crepuscular}} or {{M|Tenacious Bond}}.

{{Advantages|
*Very high [[accuracy]].
}}

{{Disadvantages|
*Very high [[recoil]] in hip-fire full-auto mode
*Linearly less efficient in [[Zoom|aimed]] fire burst mode – sometimes a target may only die with five bullets, which requires an entire second burst to be fired.
*Very poor ammo efficiency.
}}

==Acquisition==
The Quatz's blueprint can be purchased from the [[Market]].

{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

==Notes==
*Firing from hip-fire and then [[zoom]]ing in will not disrupt the full-auto fire until the trigger is released or the weapon's magazine is fully depleted.
**Respectively, firing from aimed state and then zooming out will not disrupt the burst fire mode.
**Alternating the aiming mode while firing will '''not''' change the initial firing mode base stats except [[accuracy]].
***Zooming in with full-auto increases accucary, while zooming out with burst-mode decreases it.
*When the weapon's magazine is fully depleted, reloading will produce a shockwave that stuns enemies with a guaranteed {{D|Electricity}} proc, but deals negligible damage.
**On console weapon may automatically reload before weapon is empty. Will not release electrical shockwave when this happens.
**In the event that the ''Instant Reload'' buff from {{M|Charm}} is active when the magazine is emptied, the shockwave will not generate while the magazine is instantly refilled.

==Tips==
*The hip-fire full-auto mode's high [[status chance]] allows it to apply procs rapidly, while the aimed fire burst mode's high [[critical chance]] and [[critical multiplier]] inflicts heavy raw damage.
*With {{M|Energizing Shot}} equipped, the shockwave upon reloading with an empty clip will pick up energy orbs.

==Trivia==
*The Quatz has two unique reloading animations:
**The first, which occurs when reloading with ammunition still in, has the Warframe toss the weapon and catch it by its barrel, ejecting the capacitor and putting in a new one, then tosses the weapon again and catches it by its grip.
**The second, which occurs from a fully depleted magazine, is similar to the first, but instead, the weapon is caught using the opposite hand, and the capacitor is slammed into the gun with the gun hand more forcefully while producing an {{D|Electricity}} shockwave.
*The Quatz is the second weapon that utilizes different [[Trigger Type]]s from [[Zoom|aiming]] rather than [[Alternate Fire]].
**The first weapon was the {{Weapon|Buzlok}} before its rework in {{ver|20}}, having a semi-auto trigger type upon aiming instead of automatic.
*Quatz is derived from the corruption of [[wikipedia:Quartz|Quartz]], a very common crystal of silicon dioxide. Its {{D|Electricity}} damage and the discharge produced while reloading references the [[wikipedia:Piezoelectricity|piezoelectric]] property of Quartz, the ability to produce a '''voltage''' upon the mechanical deformation of the crystal structure.

{{Codex|The Quellor was standard-issue to Dax Railjack crews of the Old War, dating back to the earliest, pre-Sigma craft. A rapid-fire assault rifle with a hefty magazine-size, the Quellor is an all-round workhorse. Also capable of large, short-range cryo-blasts. }}

The '''Quellor''' is an ancient [[Dax]] assault rifle used by [[Railjack]] crew during the Old War. Its primary fire shoots fully automatic shots with high {{D|Puncture}} damage, while its [[Alternate Fire]] charges up a short-ranged {{D|Cold}} projectile.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage on its primary fire and {{D|Cold}} damage on its [[Alternate Fire]] .
*[[Alternate Fire]] charges a single, powerful shot, for a cost of 50 ammo, that travels up to '''26''' meters, with a guaranteed {{D|Impact}} proc on enemies within '''18m''' and [[Infinite Body Punch Through]].
**Inability to hold charge.
*Primary fire has an innate 0.5 meter [[punch through]].

{{Advantages}}

{{Disadvantages}}

{{Acquisition|The Quellor's main blueprint can be obtained from defeating [[Blite Captain]], [[Glacik Commander]], <!--[[Kuva Lich Agor Rok]], -->[[Lektro Commander]], or [[Pyr Captain]] in [[Empyrean]] missions (at '''Kasio's Rest''' on [[Saturn Proxima]],  '''Flexa''' in [[Veil Proxima]], or sometimes '''Korms Belt''' in [[Earth Proxima]]). The blueprint pickup is shared across the entire squad and can be [[Trading|traded]] between players.}}
{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

==Notes==
*The alternate fire fires as soon as it has reached a full charge.
*Alternate fire has linear damage falloff from 100% to 33.43% from 9m to 18m target distance (distances are affected by [[Projectile Speed]]).
*Attempting to [[Alternate Fire]] with 49 ammo or less will cause the weapon to pause briefly, then reload.
*The Quellor might be the Dax equivalent or counterpart to the {{Weapon|Soma Prime}}: a high capacity rifle meant to mow down swaths of enemies in a single magazine, but made without typical Orokin components to be made readily available to vast crews of Dax soldiers.
* While the weapon fires hitscan bullets, the weapon features a unique trail of lasers that fire out from the weapon, acting similarly to most ballistic weaponry and their tracer rounds to track the path of your projectiles. However, they act like the effects fired from most beam weapons, and thus lag behind the reticle while aiming around, which can cause confusion as it may appear that the weapon is not hitscan and thus players may mistakenly try to lead targets.

== Known Bugs ==
* {{M|Galvanized Aptitude}} is multiplicative to base damage sources on direct hits from alt-fire.

==Tips==
*When modding for this weapon, it may be wise to focus on a hybrid build with more emphasis towards criticals. With a maxed {{M|Point Strike}} the Quellor will reach 100% critical chance on its alt fire. Using the primary fire to strip armor or remove shields may help make the alt fire even more deadly.
*Using {{M|Tactical Reload}} in the Exilus slot can help bypass the 4 second reload, and can even make using the alt fire more consistent (albeit at the cost of ammo economy).
*The alt fire has guaranteed Impact procs, and a low Fire Rate, making it perfect for applying powerful Slash procs via [[Internal Bleeding]].

==Trivia ==
*The Quellor uses a single egg-shaped object as the entire source of ammo for the weapon. When firing the orb is pushed up into position while opening a flap, then knocked back down again by the flap, a process that repeats until the weapon runs out of ammo. Then, the player will eject the orb and replace a new one inside. This implies the weapon does not use conventional ammunition and it's most likely energy based projectiles, possibly supercooled by the weapon and ejected by the energy cell.
* Highest damage of all hitscan automatic rifles.
*Alternative fire is tied with {{Weapon|Stahlta}} for the highest [[critical chance]] of all charge-up rifles.
*Third slowest [[reload speed]] of all primary rifles, after {{Weapon|Gorgon}} and {{Weapon|Trumna}}.

'''Purgator 1''' is a {{Faction|Scaldra}} slug launcher used by [[Scaldra Dedicant]]s. Shoots highly damaging single-target rounds that causes enemies to release a {{D|Gas}} cloud upon their death, but carries extremely low reserve ammo and slow reload speed.

==Characteristics==
*This weapon deals primarily {{D|Puncture}} damage.
*Enemies directly killed by Purgator 1 leave a {{D|Gas}} status effect behind.
*Innate 1.1 meter [[punch through]] and [[Infinite Body Punch Through]]

{{Advantages|class=Launcher|
}}

{{Disadvantages|class=Launcher|
}}

==Acquisition==
Purgator 1's blueprints can be purchased from [[Minerva]] of {{Faction|The Hex}} for {{sc|Standing}}; component blueprints for {{sc|5,000}} and the main blueprint for {{sc|15,000}} to a total of {{sc|30,000}}, all requiring '''Rank 5 - Pizza Party'''.

This weapon is also part of the [[Scaldra Dominance Pack]] for {{pc|655}}.

{{BuildAutomatic|type=Weapon}}

==Notes==
*Enemies directly killed by the Purgator 1 leave behind '''1''' {{D|Gas}} status effect stack.
**Kills ''must'' be directly from the projectile itself, not from any [[Damage over Time]] [[Status_Effect#Status_Effects|Status Effects]]. DoT kills will generate clouds that deal no damage.
*The Purgator 1's gas cloud deals damage each tick equal to <u>half</u> of the killing shot's damage, multiplied by any faction damage, status damage, or unique {{D|Gas}} damage bonuses.
**Gas damage is affected by damage bonuses, [[Critical Hit|critical hits]], faction damage, [[Enemy Body Parts|headshots]] and [[Status_Effect#Sources_of_Status_Damage|status damage]] mods.
**Gas damage is affected by critical damage and the critical tier of the shot that spawned the gas cloud. 
**[[Faction Damage Mods|Faction damage mods]] apply both to the killing blow, and to when the gas cloud applies its damage, effectively acting as a 169% multiplier on Bane mods, or 240% for Primed Bane mods. 
**Damage is affected by the 3.0x [[Enemy Body Parts|weakpoint multiplier]] and by bonuses to weakpoint damage, such as {{M|Primary Acuity}}.
**Multishot does not affect gas cloud damage. 
**Status chance has no effect regarding the gas cloud.
**Elemental mods and abilities that add elemental damage to weapons do not affect gas cloud damage, not even mods that combine into {{D|Gas}}. 
***However, if the killing blow also procs {{D|Gas}} on the target as a result of mods, the two {{D|Gas}} status effects will combine their damage.
**Armor, damage resistance/vulnerability, and elemental resistance/vulnerability to the Purgator 1's modded elemental damage do not affect the value of the gas.
**{{M|Fulmination}} has no effect.
*Gas clouds apply damage in the same tick as the kill occurs. This damage applies instantaneously, and will apply faster than Purgator 1's projectile can travel. This means that collateral targets may be hit with gas before the projectile.

==Tips==
*Purgator 1's slow fire rate and innate {{D|Impact}} can benefit the most from {{M|Internal Bleeding}}.
*The weapon can be used to make gas traps that further enemies can rush into for free, passive damage. Boosting status duration with {{M|Hunter Track}}, {{M|Continuous Misery}} and/or {{A|Prismatic Gem}} can greatly extend the duration of the lingering cloud. 
**Abilities such as the Noise Arrow from {{A|Quiver}} can lure enemies into the clouds while cloaked. 
**Abilities that speed enemies up such as {{A|Molecular Prime}} can make enemies rush faster into these traps and Molecular Prime specifically also doubles the damage enemies take from the clouds.
*To maximize the gas clouds as your primary source of damage, prioritize critical hits, weakpoint hits, status damage and faction damage, as well as general damage bonuses.
**Crit builds are a viable way to increase gas cloud damage, since the [[Critical_Hit#Critical_Tiers|critical tier]] of the hit that spawned the gas cloud affects the gas cloud's damage over time. 
**Weakpoint hits typically increase the damage of the hit by 3.0x, and this bonus is applied to the gas cloud.
***{{M|Primary Acuity}} causes the weakpoint multiplier to more than double to 8.25x, and massively increases the crit chance.
***{{Arcane|Primary Deadhead}} synergizes with this playstyle, as does {{M|Galvanized Scope}} and {{M|Bladed Rounds}}.
**Because Faction damage mods (such as {{M|Primed Bane of The Murmur}}) will apply first to the primary fire and then again to the gas clouds, primed Bane mods at max rank will actually increase the damage of gas clouds by around 240%.  
**{{M|Rifle Elementalist}} nearly doubles the effect of gas clouds, and extra punch-through improves the odds of a collateral projectile kill.
**{{M|Semi-Rifle Cannonade}} offers a moderate-sized boost to damage and punch-through with effectively no downside, since the low ammo max on the weapon already makes high rate-of-fire builds impractical.
**Multishot and elemental damage can be safely ignored.
*{{WF|Mesa}}'s {{A|Ballistic Battery}} will be charged by and boost the {{D|Gas}} cloud damage of the {{Weapon|Purgator 1}}.
*{{WF|Banshee}}'s {{A|Sonar}} can be very effective as the gas clouds can hit Sonar's weakpoints if they happen to attach to the body/midsection of enemies. 
**This is further improved by utilizing {{M|Resonance}} as weakpoint kills by the gas clouds will further spread the ability effect.

==Trivia==
*The Scaldra Dedicants dual wield this weapon, a feat impossible for players to replicate, similar to [[Executioner/Dhurnam|Executioner Dhurnam]]'s twin {{Weapon|Hek}}s. Their variant also functions differently, shooting green blobs that explode after a certain duration as opposed to the player usable version shooting slow-moving slug projectiles.
*The overall design seems to be based of the Hawk MM-1 grenade launcher.
*At some point shortly before release it was likely changed from firing explosive {{D|Blast}} projectiles to the current slugs. This is evident in its reduced ammo capacity and reserves, found in most explosive weapons, as well as the [[Duviri]] default mod loadout featuring Blast damage. Furthermore, the concept art referred to it as a grenade launcher.
*There are three pieces of [[1999 Language|Proto-Orokin text]] written on the weapon:
**On the stock: "Property of [[:Category:Dark Sector Reference|Lasrian]] Military" (PRAwPEhRTEeH OwV LAhSREeHAhN MIhLUhTEhREeH)
**On the scope-like attachment: Caution: FV (KAwShUhN: FV)
**On the left side of the gun's chassis: Purgator-1 (POoRGTR-1)
*The attachment on the right side of the gun is a laser sight, as seen in concept art. It does not function in-game.
